proposed_solution: Dual-path rubric in INVESTIGATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT: (1) Restore iter-1 SUPPORTED→HIGH floor for production defect patterns (guard removal, lifecycle reordering, control-flow changes, filed-defect fixes). (2) Add CLEAN-COMMIT DISCRIMINATION section scoped to known FP archetypes from EXP-FORENSICS-TAG: dependency/version bumps, comment-only compatibility signals, label/enum/property renames, mechanical API renames, type-import substitution for migration. Under discrimination: cross-version/theoretical breakage is SPECULATIVE unless diff shows wrong logic at call site; all-SPECULATIVE/UNVERIFIABLE → cap MEDIUM (router_probability cannot override). (3) Explicit opt-out: do NOT apply discrimination when guards/lifecycle/concurrency changed or CAMEL-*/JIRA fix with production logic beyond mechanical adaptation. (4) Keep iter-2a max_diff_chars=16000 unchanged. (5) REQUIRED: narrow opt-out — migration typing refactors (split CompletableFuture locals, raw-type erasure) do NOT waive discrimination when PRIMARY change is version bump or type substitution; under discrimination, rubric criterion (b) API/binary incompatibility does NOT apply to migration-driven signature or import changes. (6) FALLBACK if panel AC-4 fails on first run: add deterministic post-processing in orchestrator._assemble_report that caps risk_level to MEDIUM when reasoning marks all hypotheses SPECULATIVE/UNVERIFIABLE OR when touched_files/diff match clean archetype heuristics without guard/lifecycle/JIRA-production signals.
